name: Fantasy Citadel Skyline at Dusk
description: the skyline of a medieval high-fantasy walled citadel at dusk behind them, slate-roofed stone towers and timber-framed houses climbing to a distant keep and cathedral spires, banners stirring on the battlements, lantern and torch light glowing in the windows and streets below, warm last light on the rooftops
notes: Replaces the old generic city-skyline-dusk, which could render as a modern city. Environment only; a dragon is a separate companion/ piece (heroes/drakn-sisters/draknora/companion/pyraxis-flight.json).
